title: Reinstalling Usage Specs
description:
Just cloned a new project?  cloning a repository is only the first step. To get your development environment fully set up with Tessl, you'll need to reinstall your Usage Specs.

Much like your node_modules folder, Usage Specs are not checked into your git repository. In this quick tutorial, we show you the simple commands to get your project up and running so you can continue developing effectively.

We run through the two key commands you'll need:

- npm install to download your library dependencies.
- tessl registry install to download your Usage Specs from the Spec Registry.

After these two simple steps, your project will be fully configured and ready for Spec Driven Development.
